House move planner

For people moving home in France: a countdown checklist built on your moving date (85 typical tasks, filtered for renting or buying, removal company or rented van, children, pets, car), address changes and utility contracts with no made-up legal deadlines, every box numbered with its room and contents (search "which box has the drill?", printable colour labels), moving quotes compared per cubic metre and a moving budget. Nothing is sent on your behalf.
